demo.banner: the pharmacies, people and prices here are made up. SMS, USSD and payments are simulated, so please don't enter real health information.

landing.title: Which pharmacy has your medicine, and at what price?
landing.lead: Search the pharmacies around Buea, see what they last reported and when, then call before you go. MEDIMATE also reminds you to take the medicine your health worker prescribed.
landing.how1: Type the medicine and your area. You see verified pharmacies, the stock and price each one last reported, and how long ago.
landing.how2: Copy your prescription into MEDIMATE exactly as written. At each time you set, you get an SMS or app reminder. Reply TAKEN or SKIP.
landing.how3: If you want, log water, steps and readings, and let one family member see the parts you choose.
landing.channelsTitle: No smartphone? Use SMS or USSD.
landing.channelsLead: The same account works from a basic phone. Send a short command by SMS, or dial the menu.
landing.safetyTitle: What MEDIMATE will and won't do
landing.safety1: It never diagnoses, prescribes or changes a dose. It repeats what your prescription says.
landing.safety2: Only pharmacies an admin has checked are listed. Reports older than 48 hours are marked.
landing.safety3: A caretaker sees only the categories you tick, and you can stop sharing at any time.
landing.safety4: Reminder SMS say 'time for your medicine'. They never name the medicine or a condition.

auth.title: Sign in
auth.lead: Use your email, Google, or a code sent to your phone.
auth.phoneHint: Cameroon numbers can be written as 6XX XX XX XX.
auth.devCodeNote: Shown here because this is a fictional demo number. Real numbers get the code by SMS.

disclaimer.short: MEDIMATE does not diagnose or replace a health professional.
